# Formato de Investigaciones (`investigacion`)

> Rust CLI and full-screen terminal menu that turns an academic paper written in Markdown into a PDF: Pandoc → LaTeX (format + design) → pdflatex. Formats: APA 7 (default), Harvard, MLA 9. Designs: geometric-cover (default), classic-cover, report, starter, or user-made ones in my-templates/. Cover data comes from course profiles (courses/<key>.toml) or `--set NAME=value`. Interface in Spanish or English; papers Spanish by default. Version 2.0.0 supports Linux; Windows and macOS are planned. GPL-3.0-or-later.

Facts that are easy to get wrong:

- The Markdown holds only the content. The program adds the cover, title, author, date and table of contents.
- There is no `.env`. Data precedence: CLI option (including `--set UNIVERSIDAD=…`) > course profile. `settings.toml` only remembers the interface language (`IDIOMA`) and an optional `LOGOS` folder.
- Running `investigacion` with no arguments opens the menu; with arguments it is the CLI.
- A missing image, symbol or Graphviz is a warning. A broken ```pgfplot``` or ```tikz``` block is the only intended hard failure.
- Diagnostic log: `cache/logs/investigacion.log` (`INVESTIGACION_LOG=debug|off`).

- [README.md](README.md): what it is, install, first use
- [docs/usage.md](docs/usage.md): basic use of the menu and the CLI

- [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md): installation per OS

## Prompts

- [docs/prompts/paper.md](docs/prompts/paper.md): prompt for an AI to write a paper that uses every supported element
- [docs/prompts/design.md](docs/prompts/design.md): prompt for an AI to turn a cover description into a compatible design (template.ltx + template.toml)

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules, layout, commands for coding agents
